signals.name: invalid_user
signals.query: SELECT Address AS address, Feeder AS feeder, sum(Attempts) AS attempts FROM banoor.ssh_failures WHERE Kind = 'invalid_user' AND Minute >= now() - toIntervalSecond({window:UInt32}) GROUP BY address, feeder

signals.name: not_allowed
signals.query: SELECT Address AS address, Feeder AS feeder, sum(Attempts) AS attempts FROM banoor.ssh_failures WHERE Kind = 'not_allowed' AND Minute >= now() - toIntervalSecond({window:UInt32}) GROUP BY address, feeder
